The population of Bloom Township more than doubled between 1950 and 1970. The population of Rich Township increased by more than four times during this same period. The Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission (NIPC) projects that by 1995 there will be 150,000 people residing in Bloom Township and 250,000 residents in Rich Township, assuming that the present trends continue. The NIPC also projects that by the year 1995 there will be 1,400 acres of Agricultural and Vacant land in Bloom Township and 4,400 acres of Agricultural and Vacant land in Rich Township. This compares with the 1970 acreage of 13,600 and 14,100 for Bloom and Rich Townships for Agricultural or Vacant land.
